_meta.purpose: Mock dataset extracted from 'BuffPath Internships v2.dc.html'. Treat as the data contract for any implementation. Mirror changes in both places or neither.
notes: requirement.state is DERIVED per student, not a property of the posting. It is stored here because the prototype has one hardcoded student.
requirement.yours holds the matching resume line where one exists; empty for missing requirements.
tier is computed from applicants against seats (see decision D2), not authored.
'reword' means the student has the thing but phrased it differently from the employer. This is the state the whole extraction feature exists for.
Quoted requirement text reproduces the employer's exact phrasing; unquoted text is paraphrase.

requirementStates.missing: Genuinely absent. Becomes a prep step.
